doc.title: Charles Lloyd — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

chapter: Los Angeles, Chico Hamilton and New York
title: Meeting Eric Dolphy at Gerald Wilson's rehearsals
summary: Lloyd recalls meeting Dolphy in Gerald Wilson's band and learning decades later via his son that Dolphy was also from Memphis.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: I met Eric in Gerald Wilson’s rehearsals in his band. Gerald was very charismatic, he was from Memphis too.

You know, I didn’t know he was leaving town, and somehow I put a picture up on his birthday - Dorothy has a Facebook site for me, and so I put a picture of he and myself up, and then his son sent me an email -Anthony - saying, “My father says he loves you, and he says that Charles and I are from Memphis.” And that was so touching,

because he didn’t tell me he was from Memphis when I first came out. I didn’t know he was from Memphis at first. But I met Eric there, and then we would jam a lot, and I’d meet Eric at jam sessions. And then Eric took off cause he was playing with Chico.
